name.zh: 有据可查 evidence-check
name.en: evidence-check

problem.zh: AI 按资料写的回答和草稿，会悄悄改掉日期、数字，或者多出资料里没有的话；要让每句事实都附逐字原文，再用脚本核对
problem.en: Answers and drafts written from documents quietly shift dates and numbers or add facts no document states; every factual sentence should carry a word-for-word quote that a script checks

primary_metric.zh: 埋进去的错误被标出的比例；正确事实被误标的比例；编造数字的回答数
primary_metric.en: Planted errors flagged; correct facts wrongly flagged; answers with an invented number

summary.zh: 一个 Agent Skill 加一个核对脚本。Skill 让 Agent 给每句事实附上资料里逐字的原文；脚本核对两件事：原文真的在所引的文件里（大小写、空格、弯引号和标点不计较），以及这句话里的日期、时间、金额和数量也都出现在原文里，中英文数字互认（例如“下午2点”和 14:00）。脚本判断不了意思，所以 Skill 还要求 Agent 逐条读一遍通过的说法。两种用法：按资料回答问题；核对一篇草稿。
summary.en: An Agent Skill plus a checker script. The skill has the agent attach a word-for-word quote from the documents to every factual sentence; the script checks that the quote is really in the cited file (case, spacing, curly quotes and punctuation forgiven) and that every date, time, amount and count in the sentence also appears in its quotes, across Chinese and English numerals ("下午2点" matches 14:00). The script cannot judge meaning, so the skill also has the agent reread every passing claim. Two modes: answer from documents, and check a draft.

did.zh: 我把 TraceDesk 里逐字核对引文和数字的规则抽出来，做成谁都能装的 Skill 加核对脚本；先在开发评测里找问题、改出 v0.2，再在冻结的留出题上和普通提示比较；之后按其他几个项目实际使用这个脚本时的误报和待改清单两次改规则（0.3.0、0.4.0），每次改之前先写好新题。
did.en: I took TraceDesk's word-for-word quote and number rules out into a skill and checker anyone can install; found problems in a development run, wrote v0.2, and compared it with a plain prompt on frozen held-out items; then revised the rules twice (0.3.0, 0.4.0) from false alarms when other projects used the script and a list of known gaps, writing new items before each change.

problem.zh: 用模型初筛简历时，每个“符合 / 不符合”都要附简历原文；看它会不会更准、换名字性别学校后结论会不会变

primary_metric.zh: 逐条要求判对率；换名字等之后去留有没有变；正确的“符合”被核对误伤的比例

summary.zh: 检验一件事：让模型给每个“符合 / 不符合”附上简历原文、再用 evidence-check 的脚本核对，初筛会不会更准、在换掉名字、性别、学校、休学、婚育之后更稳。岗位和简历全部虚构，答案在写简历时定好。做了五轮评测：第一轮看准确和稳定，第二轮改核对的接法，第三轮用更乱、带陷阱的简历，第四轮在匿名简历里加民族和性别线索，第五轮把 effort 调低重跑陷阱题；另做了植入错误测试和第二次独立复核。
summary.en: Tests whether having the model attach a resume quote to every met / not-met verdict, checked by the evidence-check script, makes screening more accurate and more stable when name, gender, school, career gaps or marital details change. All jobs and resumes are fictional and answers were fixed when the resumes were written. Five rounds: accuracy and stability, a better way to wire the check, messier resumes with traps, markers of ethnicity and gender in anonymised resumes, and the traps again at a lower effort; plus planted-error tests and an independent second review.

did.zh: 我写了虚构的岗位和简历、事先定好答案，比较不附原文、附原文、附原文加脚本核对几种做法；发现核对的接法会误伤正确的判断以后，改了两版接法；再用带陷阱的新简历、植入错误和第二次独立复核检验。
did.en: I wrote fictional jobs and resumes with answers fixed in advance and compared no quotes, quotes, and quotes plus the script; after finding that the check discarded correct verdicts I rewired it twice; then tested with trap-laden new resumes, planted errors and an independent second review.

name.zh: 卖点体检
name.en: Sellpoint Check

problem.zh: 商品页的卖点有没有被买家评价证实：买家只看到被证实的卖点和原话，其余卖点私下交给商家，附修改建议
problem.en: Which listing claims do buyer reviews confirm: buyers see only confirmed claims with quotes, and the rest go privately to the merchant with suggested rewrites

primary_metric.zh: 卖点判对率（证实、反驳、有争议、没提到）；每个商品的调用次数和费用
primary_metric.en: Claims labelled correctly (supported, refuted, mixed, not mentioned); calls and cost per product

summary.zh: 把商品页的卖点拆开，在买家评价里找支持或反驳的原话，每段原话用 evidence-check 的脚本逐字核对，再给每条卖点贴上“证实、反驳、有争议、没提到”。买家页只展示被证实的卖点和原话；没被证实的进商家后台的“卖点体检”，附原话和修改建议，只有商家本人看得到。评测比较三种找证据的做法：先检索再判断（A）、逐条评价判断再汇总（B，照 PRAISE 论文的做法）、全部评价一次交给模型（C，采用）。
summary.en: The listing's claims are split out, buyer reviews are searched for quotes that support or refute each one, every quote is checked word for word by the evidence-check script, and each claim is labelled supported, refuted, mixed or not mentioned. The buyer page shows only supported claims with their quotes; the rest go to the merchant's private claim check with quotes and a suggested rewrite. The evaluation compares three ways of finding evidence: retrieve then judge (A), judge review by review and aggregate (B, after the PRAISE paper), and all reviews in one call (C, adopted).

did.en: I designed claim checking as a feature the platform and merchants share: buyers see only confirmed claims, the rest go privately to the merchant; compared three evidence-finding methods on accuracy and cost; and iterated the merchant advice six times, testing each version on new frozen items before deciding.

Every violation carries a category, the clause, the offending words and the clause text, and every quote must pass the evidence-check script before it counts. When the advertiser asks, it writes a corrected version and re-reviews the advertiser's own revision. The evaluation compares two arms: a single prompt with all material, and a tool-using agent.

problem.zh: 语音助手在用户停顿、插话、说“嗯”、背景有人说话时还能不能把事办对，体验用时延、打断、误停的数字来衡量（用户语音是合成的）
problem.en: Whether a voice assistant still gets the task right when the user pauses, interrupts, says "mm" or talks over background speech, with experience measured as latency, barge-in and false-stop numbers (the user's speech is synthesised)

primary_metric.zh: 严格通过率（事办对且交互对）；开口时延中位数；插话停下率；附和后继续说的比例

summary.zh: 测一条串联的实时语音 Agent（静音检测 → 语音识别 → 带工具的模型 → 语音合成）在 42 段写好的中英对话里的表现：停顿、插话、附和词、噪声、工具调用。每段对话的答案在写题时定好，跑前冻结题目、音频和打分脚本。先测三种基线设置和纯文字对照，再在同一套题上一项一项试改进：附和不算打断、先暂停再确认、第一段语音切短、删除前先确认、只听主说话人，最后把有效的合在一起。
summary.en: Measures a cascaded real-time voice agent (voice activity detection → speech recognition → a model with tools → speech synthesis) on 42 scripted Chinese and English conversations covering pauses, interruptions, backchannels, noise and tool calls. Answers were fixed when the items were written; items, audio and scorer were frozen before the run. Three baseline settings and a text-only control come first; fixes are then tried one at a time on the same items (backchannels are not barge-ins, pause before cancelling, a shorter first speech chunk, confirm before deleting, listen only to the primary speaker), and the useful ones are combined.

did.zh: 我写了 42 段带停顿、插话、附和和噪声的对话、事先定好答案，搭了一条本机串联的语音 Agent 做基线；然后一项一项试改进，每项先写补充预注册再跑，最后把有效的合在一起。
did.en: I wrote 42 conversations with pauses, barge-ins, backchannels and noise, answers fixed in advance, and built a local cascaded voice agent as the baseline; then tried fixes one at a time, each with its own preregistration addendum, and combined the ones that worked.

name.zh: 有据标注流水线
name.en: Grounded Labelling Pipeline

problem.zh: 能核对的回答，怎么变成团队每天用的审核工作流：拿不准的交给人复核，提示词能灰度、能回滚
problem.en: How checkable answers become a review workflow a team runs daily: unsure cases go to people, and prompts ship with canary release and rollback

primary_metric.zh: 漏网错判（判错又自动生效）；送人工复核的比例；判对率
primary_metric.en: Wrong decisions that went live; share sent to human review; decisions right

summary.zh: 一条围绕有据审核搭的审核和标注工作流。每条广告先由模型判断并引原文，再用 evidence-check 核对引文，核对没过、读不出或模型拿不准的进人工复核队列，复核结果和模型不同的变成新的回归题。提示词按版本管理，新版本先做回归测试，再按事先写好的规则灰度放量，触发就回滚。另有一个只按政策库回答的知识库问答，库里没有管这件事的条款就说没有。流量是有据审核评测题的回放，不是真实用户；回放里的复核结论就是题目定好的答案。
summary.en: A review and labelling workflow built around Grounded Review. Each ad is decided by the model with quotes, the quotes are checked by evidence-check, and ads that fail the check, cannot be read or that the model is unsure of go to a human review queue; reviewed ads that differ from the model become new regression items. Prompts are versioned; a new version passes a regression test, then a canary release under rules written beforehand, and rolls back when a rule fires. A knowledge-base Q&A answers only from the policy library and says so when no clause covers the question. Traffic is a replay of Grounded Review's test items, not real users; reviewer decisions in the replay are the items' fixed answers.

did.zh: 我把有据审核做成一条四步审核工作流：模型判断，evidence-check 核对引文，核对没过或模型拿不准的进人工复核队列，复核结果回流成回归题；另加政策库检索评测、只按政策库回答的知识库问答、提示词版本、灰度和回滚规则、用 SQL 取数的每周报告和上线检查清单，并在 Lark 多维表格里搭了判断和复核两条工作流。
did.en: I turned Grounded Review into a four-step review workflow: the model decides, evidence-check verifies the quotes, ads that fail the check or that the model is unsure of go to a human review queue, and reviewed ads come back as regression items; plus a policy retrieval evaluation, a knowledge-base Q&A that answers only from the policy library, prompt versions, canary and rollback rules, weekly reports computed in SQL and a launch checklist, with judging and review workflows built in a Lark Base.

name.zh: 有据经营分析
name.en: Grounded Business Review

problem.zh: 每周看经营数据的人要知道哪些指标异动、原因在哪；让模型找原因、写周报，原因找得准不准，周报里的数字能不能都对回查询结果（在合成数据上测）
problem.en: Whoever reads the weekly numbers needs to know which metrics moved and why; when a model finds the cause and writes the review, is the cause right, and does every number trace back to a query result? (tested on synthetic data)

primary_metric.zh: 埋好的原因全找对（不多报、不答粗）；改一次以内放行的周报；每题费用
primary_metric.en: Every planted cause found (nothing extra, nothing too coarse); reviews released after at most one revision; cost per case

summary.zh: 在一份合成的到店团购数据上，把“每周监控 → 按维度拆解 → 写经营周报 → 数字核对”做成一条可以重跑的线，并比较三种找原因的做法：固定规则的脚本、把固定查询结果交给模型的一次提示词、让模型自己用工具查数的 Agent。周报里每段带数字的话都要引用查询结果的行，用 evidence-check 逐段核对，对不上就退回改一次，再不过就不放行。数据由脚本按随机种子生成，不是任何平台的真实经营数据。
summary.en: On synthetic local-services group-buying data, "weekly monitor → breakdown by dimension → weekly review → number check" runs as one repeatable line, and three ways of finding the cause are compared: a fixed-rule script, a one-prompt approach that hands the model a fixed pack of query results, and an agent that queries with tools. Every paragraph with a number must cite the query-result row it comes from and is checked with evidence-check; a review that fails goes back for one revision and is held back if it fails again. The data is generated by script from random seeds and is not any platform's real business data.

did.zh: 我在合成的到店团购数据上搭了指标字典、一条 SQL 的周监控、贡献度和率效应拆解、带数字核对的经营周报，比较固定脚本、一次提示词和 Agent 三种找原因的做法；埋好答案的测试题和评测计划在跑之前冻结；另把同一条流程搭成 Dify 工作流。
did.en: On synthetic local-services group-buying data I built a metric dictionary, a one-query weekly monitor, contribution and rate-mix breakdowns and number-checked weekly reviews, and compared three ways of finding the cause: a fixed-rule script, a one-prompt approach and an agent; the known-answer test cases and the evaluation plan were frozen before the run; the same flow was also built as a Dify workflow.

Subtitle checking compares every auto-caption with the script and checks reading speed and timing; shot-list checking checks that each shot's voiceover can be spoken in time, that no line of the script is lost and that the total length fits; trend topics checks every fact on a topic card: the link opens, the title matches, the quote is on the page, the numbers are in the quote and the page is recent. did.zh: 我做了三个给短视频创作者用的 Agent Skill：字幕对稿、分镜核对、热点选题。每个都带一个核对脚本，结果交出去之前先查一遍。每个都和不装 Skill 的同一个模型在事先定好答案的题上比较，计划和预测跑前冻结。
did.en: I built three Agent Skills for short-video creators: subtitle checking, shot-list checking and trend topics. Each carries a checking script that runs before anything is handed back. problem.zh: 按广告政策审核短视频广告，模型要看到什么才够；用合成广告训练的小模型能不能胜任

primary_metric.zh: 判断正确率；违规抓到的比例；合规广告被错拒的比例

summary.zh: 按广告政策审核短视频广告的三组实验，都在一台笔记本显卡上跑，方案和预测跑前预注册。第一组比较同一段广告给模型看文案、封面、抽帧、整段视频或帧上识别出的文字时审得准不准；第二组用合成广告微调小模型，在有据审核的测试题、视频文字和真实案例上和大模型比；第三组拿另一平台 300 条真实短视频核对“违不违规”。真实视频和真实案例只公开汇总数字。
summary.en: Three experiments on reviewing short video ads against policy, all on one laptop GPU, with plans and predictions preregistered. The first compares what a model is shown of the same ad: caption, cover, sampled frames, the whole video, or text read off the frames. The second fine-tunes small models on synthetic ads and compares them with a large model on Grounded Review's test items, video text and real cases. The third checks 300 real short videos from another platform for a yes/no violation call. For the real videos and real cases only totals are published.

did.zh: 我在一台笔记本显卡上按预注册的方案做了三组实验：一条短视频广告要让模型看到什么（文案、封面、抽帧、整段视频、帧上识别的文字）才审得准；用合成广告微调的小模型能不能比得上大模型；再拿 300 条另一平台的真实短视频核对。最后对照近一年的研究写了一份调研报告。
did.en: On a laptop GPU I ran three preregistered experiments: what a model needs to see of a short video ad (caption, cover, sampled frames, the whole video, text read off the frames) to review it well; whether small models fine-tuned on synthetic ads match a large model; and a check on 300 real short videos from another platform. A survey of the past year's research closes it.

summary.zh: 检验一个模型裁判能信到什么程度。三种标准分开比：出题时定好答案的判断题（审核意见、简历判断、修改建议）、监管机构和法院对真实广告的结论、公开数据集自带的人工评分（Judge's Verdict、SummEval、WMT MQM 中译英）。再按结果把检查分成三类：能用脚本查的、能交给裁判的、必须留给人的，比较“只用裁判”和“先规则、再裁判、拿不准的送人工”两种接法；最后做了一个用两个工具的质检 Agent，并按模拟批次给它定验收标准。没有为这个项目另做人工评分。
summary.en: Measures how far one model judge can be trusted, against three standards kept apart: items with answers fixed when they were built (review opinions, resume verdicts, revision advice), regulator and court decisions on real ads, and the human ratings that ship with public datasets (Judge's Verdict, SummEval, WMT MQM Chinese to English). The results sort checks into three kinds: for a script, for the judge, and for people; the judge alone is compared with rules first, then the judge, with unsure items sent to people. Last, a quality-check agent with two tools gets an acceptance standard tested on simulated batches. No human ratings were collected for this project.

did.zh: 我把一个模型裁判分别和三种标准比：出题时定好的答案、监管和法院的结论、公开数据集自带的人工评分；再定出哪些检查交给脚本、哪些交给裁判、哪些留给人，并做了一个带验收标准的质检 Agent。方案、冻结的文件和预测跑前写好。
did.en: I measured one model judge against three standards kept apart: answers fixed when the items were built, regulator and court decisions, and the human ratings that ship with public datasets; then set which checks go to a script, a judge or a person, and built a quality-check agent with an acceptance standard. The plan, frozen files and predictions were written before the runs.

summary.zh: 一个换一套规则和案例就能接新任务的内容标注 Agent，配一整套用证据调它的工具：预注册的 A/B 对照、每个标签的精确率和召回率（带区间）、混淆和切片、失败样本根因表，以及按根因改版后在没用过的样本上验证。流程是：先检索相似案例，再用规则和案例工具标注，代码负责规则门（没读规则就给的标签，补发规则）、原话修正和自查。两个任务：中英文广告政策标签（每种语言 7 类，答案在写广告时定好），和公开数据集 ASAP 的餐厅点评 18 个方面（标签是数据集自带的）。五种做法从短提示词到“查规则 + 检索案例 + 自查”逐步加，点评另比较真实、合成和一半一半三种案例库。方案、假设和冻结文件跑前写好；最好的做法的失败样本，每个错误判断独立归因两次；按根因改出第二版，冻结后才在测试集 B 上跑。
summary.en: A content-labelling agent that plugs into any labelling task through a folder of rules and cases, and the kit to tune it with evidence: preregistered A/B experiments, per-label precision and recall with intervals, confusion and slices, a root-cause table of failures, and a revision checked on items it never saw. The flow: retrieve similar cases, label with rule and case tools, and let code run a rule gate (labels given without reading their rule get the rule sent), quote repair and a self-check. Two tasks: ad-policy labels in Chinese and English (7 per language, answers fixed when each ad was written) and 18 aspects of restaurant reviews from the public ASAP dataset (the dataset's own labels). Five arms add one piece at a time, from a short prompt to rules plus retrieved cases plus a self-check; on reviews, real, synthetic and half-and-half case libraries are also compared. Plan, hypotheses and frozen files were written before the runs; each wrong decision of the best arm was classified twice, independently; the revision built from the causes was frozen before it ran on test B.

did.zh: 我做了一个通用的内容标注 Agent：换一个放规则和案例的文件夹就能接新任务。用两个任务、五种做法做预注册的 A/B 对照，算每个标签的精确率和召回率、混淆和切片；把最好的做法的失败样本归到五类根因，按根因改出第二版，再在没用过的测试集上检验。常用的分析做成了五个 Agent Skill。
did.en: I built one content-labelling agent that takes on a new task through a folder of rules and cases. Two tasks and five arms go through preregistered A/B comparisons, with per-label precision and recall, confusion and slices; the best arm's failures are sorted into five root causes, a second version is built from them and checked on a test set nothing was tuned on. The common analyses are packaged as five Agent Skills.

summary.zh: 评一个会调工具的 Agent 每一步做了什么，不只看最后的答案。三个已有的 Agent 照原样运行（有据审核、有据经营分析、创作者 Skill），46 道新题：广告审核 20、经营分析 18、创作流程 8，从一步就能答的题到多轮对话、要拿捏分寸的题分成三档，每题三次。题目和答案在出题时定好，题目、答案、评分代码和配置跑前记下指纹。评分是对过程记录的规则检查，分五个阶段；任务成功只看结果检查，过程检查用来说明它怎么走到这一步。另有上线前的自动关卡（引文核对、数字核对、Skill 自带的检查脚本），关卡拦下的要人确认；失败归因记下每个失败从哪一步开始、为什么、怎么改。
summary.en: Evaluates what a tool-using agent does at every step, not only its final answer. Three existing agents run unchanged (Grounded Review, Grounded Business Review, Creator Skills) on 46 new tasks: 20 ad review, 18 business review and 8 creator workflow, in three tiers from one-step tasks to multi-turn ones that need judgement, three trials each. Answers were fixed when the tasks were written, and tasks, answers, rubric code and configurations were hashed before the runs. Scoring is rule checks over the recorded steps in five stages; task success uses the result checks only, and process checks explain how the agent got there. Release gates (quote checks, number checks, the skills' own checking scripts) hold results for a person; the attribution table records where each failure starts, why, and how to fix it.

did.zh: 我给三个已有的、会调工具的 Agent 新写了 46 道题，每题跑三次，把每一步记下来；评分按理解、规划、工具调用、知识引用、结果五个阶段写成规则，再加上线前的自动关卡和失败归因表。看完基线后，跑之前先写下两个修复的预测，再在整组题上做回归重测。
did.en: I wrote 46 new tasks for three existing tool-using agents, ran each three times and recorded every step; scoring is written as rules over five stages (understanding, planning, tool calls, knowledge and citation, result), with release gates and a failure attribution table on top. After the base run, two fixes were registered with predictions before they ran, then re-tested on every task of their family.

summary.zh: 给类目团队的招商“第一周作业”：行业洞察、本地品牌、经销商和连锁店的打分商家池、按品类的资质清单、入驻跟进表、头 30 天的 SQL 和触达模板。评的是这份材料里的每条事实：引文要在存档页面里，数字要在引文里，商家池的引文里还要有能当证据的词；对不上，构建就停下。
summary.en: A first-week recruiting pack for a category team: industry insight, a scored pool of local brands, distributors and retailers, a per-category approvals checklist, an onboarding tracker, first-30-days SQL and outreach templates. What is evaluated is every fact in the pack: the quote must be in the saved page, the number in the quote, and a pool quote must contain a word that counts as evidence; if not, the build stops.

did.zh: 我先查了现成的店铺排行工具：它们只排已经在平台上的商家，回答不了“还没进来或还没做起来的商家里先招谁”。于是用公开来源补这一块：存下官方、市场和品牌的公开页面，写出行业洞察和按品类的资质清单；打分规则在填写任何一行之前写好并冻结，按它给本地品牌、经销商和连锁店排出先后；再配上入驻跟进表、头 30 天的 SQL 和触达模板。每条事实和商家池的每一格都用 evidence-check 对回存档原文。
did.en: I first checked the existing shop-ranking tools: they rank merchants already on a platform and cannot answer "which merchants not yet there, or not yet large, to recruit first". This pack fills that gap from public sources: saved official, market and brand pages, an industry insight and a per-category approvals checklist; scoring rules written and frozen before any row was filled, ranking local brands, distributors and retailers; then an onboarding tracker, first-30-days SQL and outreach templates. Every fact and every cell of the pool is checked against its saved page with evidence-check.
